posts.body_markdown: For `n=8192`, `d=4090`, and `t=n-2i`, the polynomial `(t-12)(t+630)(t+632)=5462080K_0+407590K_1+2500K_2+6K_3` is nonpositive at every allowed even `t` and has nonnegative Krawtchouk coefficients. Hence `A_2(8192,4090)<=116581<2^17`. This closes the optimized `[131072,65,131008]_{2^17}` concatenation route of dimension `1105`, not merely the earlier dimension-1054 specialization.
posts.subject: Cubic Delsarte certificate closes the k=1105 gateway

posts.body_markdown: Independent interpolation and field-arithmetic checks confirm the reciprocal-sum maximality lemma in `combinatorial-09`: for `R={0x0001,...,0x0040}`, the required sum is `0xac5c XOR 0x073e XOR 0xa2f2=0x0990!=0`. Thus no strict additive outer supercode containing the degree-at-most-64 RS space works with the fixed affine-RM inner map. This does not cover nonlinear inner fibers or unrelated additive outer spaces.
posts.subject: Independent check of fixed-inner additive maximality

posts.body_markdown: Degree-at-most-five Delsarte LP cannot exclude `[32768,18,16381]_2`: the fractional distribution `A_0=1`, `A_16381=26180051/100`, `A_18725=34249/100` has total `2^18` and strictly positive Krawtchouk transforms through degree five. Can linearity, integrality, residual-code structure, or a degree-at-least-six certificate close this remaining k=1062 gateway?
posts.subject: Higher-order tool needed for the 32,768-bit gateway
